meta.status: draft: thresholds are starting values, calibrate with real before/after pairs before release
meta.approach: Deterministic measurement. Both photos are mapped onto the same ARKit face mesh, makeup is found by colour difference against the bare face, measured in millimetres and degrees against the target the user chose on Try On, and each measurement is matched to a band and a written instruction. No AI or machine learning.
meta.privacy: Photos, meshes and landmarks are held in memory for the session only. Nothing is written to disk or sent anywhere.
meta.owner: Nimah (feedback); rule texts per tool checked by the tool PIC (blush Nimah, brow Khalish, eyeliner Hanum)

before.when: Try On, after the user picks a look and taps the photo button
keeps: camera_image: raw ARKit camera frame with NO virtual makeup drawn (bare face baseline)
rendered_image: the same frame with the virtual makeup, shown to the user only
face_vertices: ARFaceGeometry vertices, face-local metres (1220 points)
blend_shapes: ARKit blend shapes (eyeBlink, mouthSmile, browInnerUp, browOuterUp, jawOpen)
landmarks_2d: MediaPipe Face Landmarker 478 points on camera_image
landmarks_3d: the 478 points lifted onto the face mesh (BrowFaceFrame.faceLocal), face-local metres
targets: per tool, the target geometry the engine drew (see target_geometry)
choices: tool looks, shades (sRGB), intensities from TutorialHandoff

after.when: end of the tutorial, photo step
keeps: camera_image, face_anchor_transform, face_vertices, blend_shapes, landmarks_2d, landmarks_3d (same as before)

photos.pairing: Both photos are compared in the ARKit face mesh's UV space (same 1220-vertex topology), so head pose, distance and phone angle between the two photos do not move the makeup. Each photo's pixels are sampled into a 1024 x 1024 UV atlas through its own face mesh and camera projection.
photos.reduced_mode: No before photo (user skipped it): skip every metric that needs the bare baseline (intensity, hue, spill based on colour change); measure the rest against the target geometry only, and say so in the summary.

face_frame.source: ARKit ARFaceAnchor face-local space, metres, converted to millimetres (x 1000)
face_frame.axes: x: across the face, y: up (towards the forehead), z: out of the face towards the camera
face_frame.per_side: Each side is mirrored into 'lateral' coordinates so one set of thresholds serves both sides: lateral = |x| measured outward from the face midline (positive towards the ear), vertical = y (positive up). 'inward' = towards the nose, 'outward' = towards the ear.
face_frame.plane: Positions and angles are measured in the face's frontal plane (x, y) after the mesh is aligned, so a tilted head does not change them.

coordinates.sides: Sides are the user's own left and right. The front camera preview is mirrored, so the user's left is also on the left of the screen.

units.mm: millimetres on the face (ARKit TrueDepth is metric)
units.deg: degrees in the frontal plane; positive = rising towards the outer end (temple / ear)
units.pct: percent of an area or a length
units.dE: CIEDE2000 colour difference in CIELAB, D65
units.dh: hue angle difference in CIELCh, degrees

scale.ipd_mm: inter-pupil distance from landmarks 468 and 473 (iris centres), in mm
scale.rule: Every mm threshold marked scale:'ipd' is multiplied by (ipd_mm / 63). A small face gets tighter limits, a large face looser ones.

local_frames.cheek: origin = target blush centre of that cheek; lateral axis outward, vertical axis up
local_frames.brow: u along the target brow centreline: 0 = target head, 1 = target tail (mm along it = u x target length); v perpendicular, positive up, in mm
local_frames.eye: origin = inner eye corner (landmark 133 right eye / 362 left eye); x towards the outer corner (263 / 33) along the eye axis; y perpendicular, positive up; eye_width = inner-to-outer corner distance in mm

skin_reference.note: used for exposure / white balance normalisation

target_geometry.blush: BlushPigmentField per cheek from the engine at the before photo: centre (lateral, vertical mm), radii (mm), angle (deg, outward_up_angle), wash profile. target_core = ellipse scaled 0.38 (tutorial inner circle), target_area = ellipse scaled 0.82 (tutorial outer line), target_limit = ellipse scaled 1.0. Sunkissed adds the nose-bridge band; Lifted's ellipse reaches the temple.
target_geometry.brow: The chosen BrowOverlay picture mapped onto the user's brow in brow space at the before photo: target centreline (u 0..1), target head point, tail point, arch point (highest v), thickness profile along u, target mask.
target_geometry.eyeliner: The EyelinerPlanner solution per eye at the before photo (LinerSpec): upper line path along the lash line, thickness profile (fraction of eye width) for inner/middle/outer thirds, start point, wing origin, wing angle (deg, positive lifts), wing length (mm), wing tip, lower line (enabled for Arabian, extent, thickness).

normalise.exposure_white_balance: Per photo, take the mean Lab of skin_reference patches (forehead centre, chin, both away from makeup). Scale the after photo so its reference L*, a*, b* match the before photo before comparing.
normalise.max_correction: If the needed L* correction is above 12 or a*/b* above 6, the lighting changed too much: capture rule lighting_mismatch.

makeup_mask.blush: texel counts as blush when after vs before: dC* >= 4 and dE00 >= 3, hue within 60 deg of the chosen shade's hue
makeup_mask.brow: texel counts as brow product when after is darker than before by dL* >= 4 inside or near the brow, or the hair mask grew (texel was skin in before, hair-coloured in after)
makeup_mask.eyeliner: texel counts as liner when after L* <= 35 (or dL* <= -15 vs before) within 6 mm of the lash line; colour liners: dE00 >= 8 towards the chosen shade

detection.cleanup: Remove blobs smaller than 2 mm^2, close 1 mm holes, then measure. Hair and hands found by the face-skin segmenter are excluded and reported by capture rules.

ok.shows: praise only (at most one per tool)

slight.meaning: visible to a careful eye; a small touch fixes it

clear.meaning: clearly different from the target; needs a specific fix

large.meaning: far from the target; easier to remove and redo that part

how_to_read_thresholds.abs: |measured - target| <= ok -> ok; <= slight -> slight; <= clear -> clear; else large. Direction from the sign.
how_to_read_thresholds.min: measured >= ok -> ok; >= slight -> slight; >= clear -> clear; else large (bigger is better, e.g. coverage).
how_to_read_thresholds.max: measured <= ok -> ok; <= slight -> slight; <= clear -> clear; else large (smaller is better, e.g. spill).
how_to_read_thresholds.ratio: f = max(r, 1/r) with r = measured/target; f <= ok -> ok; <= slight -> slight; <= clear -> clear; else large. Direction: r > 1 or r < 1.

id.summary_side: Sisi kiri dan kanan adalah kiri dan kanan wajahmu sendiri (sama seperti di layar kamera depan).

en.summary_side: Left and right are your own left and right (the same as on the front camera screen).

placeholders.{part}: the side-specific part name from VOCAB (cheek / brow / eye) for the rule's tool, or 'both' when merged
placeholders.{delta}: absolute difference, rounded: mm to 0.5, deg to 1, pct to 5
placeholders.{zone}: VOCAB zone for the rule (where the problem is largest)
placeholders.{zone2}: second zone, when two zones are reported
placeholders.{other}: the other side in symmetry rules

order: 1. Capture rules run first. A 'blocking' capture rule stops analysis and shows only its retake instruction.
2. Every metric of every tool that was on is measured per side, then mapped to a band.
3. Left and right hits of the same rule, same direction and same band are merged into one message with {part} = both.
4. Suppression: a rule listed in another hit's 'suppresses' is dropped when that other hit has an equal or worse band.
5. Hits are sorted by band (large, clear, slight), then by priority (lower number first), then by delta.
6. Per tool show at most 3 hits; if a tool has no hit worse than ok, show its praise message instead.
7. Overall summary first (summary_templates), then tools in the order Blush, Brow, Eyeliner.
selection.tool_score: weighted mean of metric band scores (metric weight in each metric); ok = 100, slight = 80, clear = 55, large = 25
selection.overall_score: mean of the tool scores of the tools that were on

id.say: Blush di {part} sedikit keluar dari area garis putus-putus. Rapikan pinggiran luarnya dengan spons bersih.

en.title: Blush slightly wide
en.say: The blush on your {part} goes a little past the dotted area. Tidy the outer edge with a clean sponge.

id.title: Blush terlalu lebar
id.say: Blush di {part} melebar jauh keluar area garis putus-putus. Usap pinggiran yang keluar garis luar dengan spons bersih atau tisu.

en.title: Blush too wide
en.say: The blush on your {part} spreads well past the dotted area. Wipe what goes past the outer line with a clean sponge or tissue.

id.title: Blush jauh terlalu lebar
id.say: Blush di {part} menutupi hampir seluruh pipi. Hapus dan ulangi dengan jumlah lebih sedikit.
steps: Hapus blush di pipi itu.
Ambil blush setengah dari sebelumnya.
Tepuk di lingkaran kecil, baurkan hanya sampai garis luar.

en.title: Blush far too wide
en.say: The blush on your {part} covers almost the whole cheek. Remove it and start again with less product.
steps: Remove the blush on that cheek.
Use half as much product as before.
Dab in the small circle and blend only to the outer line.

rules.measure: share of target_area covered by the blush mask; {zone} = the zone (inner / outer / upper / lower / center) with the lowest coverage

id.title: Ada bagian yang belum terisi
id.say: Blush di {part} sudah mengisi sebagian besar area garis putus-putus. {zone} masih kosong: tepuk sedikit di sana lalu baurkan.

en.title: A part is still bare
en.say: The blush on your {part} fills most of the dotted area. The {zone} is still bare: dab a little there and blend.

id.title: Blush belum rata
id.say: Blush di {part} baru mengisi sebagian area garis putus-putus, paling kosong di {zone}. Tambah blush di sana dengan tepukan kecil, lalu baurkan ke seluruh lingkaran luar.

en.title: Blush not even yet
en.say: The blush on your {part} fills only part of the dotted area, emptiest in the {zone}. Dab more there, then blend across the outer circle.

id.title: Blush baru sedikit
id.say: Blush di {part} baru mengisi sebagian area garis putus-putus. Ulangi langkah 2: baurkan dari lingkaran kecil keluar sampai garis luar.

en.title: Very little blush
en.say: The blush on your {part} fills only part of the dotted area. Repeat step 2: blend from the small circle out to the outer line.

rules.measure: mean dC* of the blush mask inside target_core divided by the dC* the virtual blush produced at the chosen intensity (from the before photo's rendered vs camera image)

id.title: Blush sedikit terlalu tebal
id.say: Blush di {part} sedikit lebih pekat dari look pilihanmu. Tepuk bagian tengah dengan spons bersih untuk mengangkat sedikit warna.

en.title: Blush slightly heavy
en.say: The blush on your {part} is a little stronger than your chosen look. Press the centre with a clean sponge to lift a little colour.

id.title: Blush terlalu tebal
id.say: Blush di {part} lebih pekat dari Try On. Tekan-tekan dengan spons bersih atau tisu sampai warnanya turun, lalu baurkan pinggirannya.

en.title: Blush too heavy
en.say: The blush on your {part} is stronger than your try-on. Press with a clean sponge or tissue until the colour drops, then blend the edges.

id.title: Blush jauh terlalu tebal
id.say: Blush di {part} lebih pekat dari Try On. Lebih mudah dihapus dan diulang dengan sedikit produk.
steps: Hapus blush di pipi itu.
Ambil produk sedikit saja, lalu ketuk kuas atau jari di tisu sekali.
Tepuk di lingkaran kecil dan baurkan. Tambah lagi hanya kalau masih kurang.

en.title: Blush far too heavy
en.say: The blush on your {part} is stronger than your try-on. It is easier to remove it and start again with a little product.
steps: Remove the blush on that cheek.
Pick up very little product and tap the brush or finger on a tissue once.
Dab in the small circle and blend. Add more only if needed.

id.title: Blush sedikit terlalu tipis
id.say: Blush di {part} sedikit lebih tipis dari look pilihanmu. Tambah satu tepukan tipis di tengah.

en.title: Blush slightly light
en.say: The blush on your {part} is a little lighter than your chosen look. Add one light dab in the centre.

id.title: Blush terlalu tipis
id.say: Blush di {part} masih jauh lebih tipis dari Try On. Tambah produk sedikit demi sedikit di lingkaran kecil, lalu baurkan.

en.title: Blush too light
en.say: The blush on your {part} is much lighter than your try-on. Build it up little by little in the small circle, then blend.

id.title: Blush hampir tidak terlihat
id.say: Blush di {part} masih jauh lebih tipis dari Try On. Ulangi langkah 1 dengan produk sedikit lebih banyak.

en.title: Blush barely visible
en.say: The blush on your {part} is much lighter than your try-on. Repeat step 1 with a little more product.

rules.measure: blush mask area outside target_limit in this zone, as % of target_area

id.title: Sedikit naik ke bawah mata
id.say: Ada sedikit blush di luar garis, ke arah mata. Usap tipis dengan spons bersih ke arah bawah.

en.title: A little up under the eye
en.say: Some blush is a little past the line towards the eye. Wipe it lightly downward with a clean sponge.

id.title: Blush masuk ke area bawah mata
id.say: Blush keluar garis ke arah mata. Hapus bagian di bawah mata dengan cotton bud dan sedikit micellar water.

en.title: Blush under the eye
en.say: Blush goes past the line towards the eye. Remove the part under the eye with a cotton bud and a little micellar water.

id.title: Banyak blush di bawah mata
id.say: Banyak blush naik sampai bawah mata. Hapus area itu dan baurkan ulang hanya sampai garis luar.

en.title: Lots of blush under the eye
en.say: Much of the blush reaches under the eye. Remove that area and blend again only to the outer line.

rules.note: sunkissed: the nose-bridge band is part of the target, see blush.sunkissed.*

id.title: Sedikit masuk ke samping hidung
id.say: Ada sedikit blush di luar garis, ke arah hidung. Baurkan ke arah telinga.

en.title: A little beside the nose
en.say: Some blush is a little past the line towards the nose. Blend it towards the ear.

id.title: Blush masuk ke samping hidung
id.say: Blush keluar garis ke arah hidung. Usap bagian samping hidung dengan spons bersih.

en.title: Blush beside the nose
en.say: Blush goes past the line towards the nose. Wipe beside the nose with a clean sponge.

id.title: Banyak blush di samping hidung
id.say: Banyak blush di samping hidung. Hapus bagian itu dengan micellar water, lalu baurkan ulang dari lingkaran kecil ke arah luar.

en.title: Lots of blush beside the nose
en.say: A lot of blush sits beside the nose. Remove it with micellar water, then blend again from the small circle outward.

id.title: Sedikit turun ke bawah
id.say: Ada sedikit blush di bawah garis luar. Usap tipis pinggiran bawah ke arah atas.

en.title: A little too low
en.say: Some blush is a little below the outer line. Wipe the lower edge lightly upward.

id.title: Blush turun ke arah mulut
id.say: Blush keluar garis ke bawah. Usap bagian bawah dengan spons bersih sampai batas garis luar.

en.title: Blush drifting to the mouth
en.say: Blush goes below the line. Wipe the lower part with a clean sponge up to the outer line.

id.title: Banyak blush di pipi bawah
id.say: Banyak blush di pipi bawah. Hapus bagian itu, lalu baurkan ulang ke atas.

en.title: Lots of blush low on the cheek
en.say: A lot of blush sits low on the cheek. Remove that part, then blend again upward.

rules.note: lifted reaches the temple by design

id.title: Sedikit melebar ke telinga
id.say: Ada sedikit blush di luar garis, ke arah telinga. Baurkan pinggirannya sampai hilang.

en.title: A little towards the ear
en.say: Some blush is a little past the line towards the ear. Blend the edge until it disappears.

id.title: Blush melebar ke telinga
id.say: Blush keluar garis ke arah telinga. Usap ujung luar dengan spons bersih.

en.title: Blush spreading to the ear
en.say: Blush goes past the line towards the ear. Wipe the outer end with a clean sponge.

id.title: Banyak blush di dekat telinga
id.say: Banyak blush sampai dekat telinga. Hapus bagian itu dan baurkan ulang hanya sampai garis luar.

en.title: Lots of blush near the ear
en.say: A lot of blush reaches the ear. Remove that part and blend again only to the outer line.

id.title: Sedikit turun ke rahang
id.say: Ada sedikit blush turun ke arah rahang. Baurkan ke atas.

en.title: A little towards the jaw
en.say: Some blush runs down to the jaw. Blend it upward.

id.title: Blush turun ke rahang
id.say: Blush keluar garis ke arah rahang. Usap bagian itu dengan spons bersih.

en.title: Blush on the jaw
en.say: Blush goes past the line to the jaw. Wipe that part with a clean sponge.

id.title: Banyak blush di rahang
id.say: Banyak blush di rahang. Hapus dan baurkan ulang ke arah tulang pipi.

en.title: Lots of blush on the jaw
en.say: A lot of blush is on the jaw. Remove it and blend again towards the cheekbone.

rules.measure: median distance over which intensity drops from 80% to 20% across the blush boundary, along 36 rays from the centre; {zone} = the side with the hardest edge

id.title: Pinggiran sedikit tegas
id.say: Pinggiran blush di {part} masih terlihat, terutama di {zone}. Putar spons atau jari kecil-kecil di pinggiran itu.

en.title: Edge slightly sharp
en.say: The edge on your {part} still shows, mostly at the {zone}. Make small circles over that edge with a sponge or finger.

id.title: Pinggiran terlihat tegas
id.say: Ada garis tegas di pinggiran blush {part} di {zone}. Buff dengan gerakan memutar kecil ke arah luar sampai garisnya hilang.

en.title: Hard edge
en.say: There is a hard line at the edge on your {part} at the {zone}. Buff in small circles outward until the line is gone.

id.title: Blush seperti tempelan
id.say: Blush di {part} berhenti mendadak, seperti stiker. Ulangi langkah 3: buff memutar kecil dari pinggiran ke luar, tanpa menambah produk.

en.title: Blush looks stuck on
en.say: The blush on your {part} stops abruptly, like a sticker. Redo step 3: buff in small circles from the edge outward without adding product.

rules.measure: coefficient of variation of dC* inside target_core after a 3 mm blur; {zone} = darkest patch's zone

id.title: Warna sedikit belang
id.say: Warna di {part} sedikit tidak rata, lebih pekat di {zone}. Tepuk-tepuk area itu dengan spons bersih.

en.title: Slightly patchy
en.say: The colour on your {part} is a little uneven, stronger at the {zone}. Pat that area with a clean sponge.

id.title: Warna belang
id.say: Blush di {part} belang: ada bagian pekat di {zone}. Tekan bagian pekat dengan spons, lalu baurkan merata.

en.title: Patchy colour
en.say: The blush on your {part} is patchy, with a strong patch at the {zone}. Press the strong part with a sponge, then blend evenly.

id.title: Warna sangat belang
id.say: Blush di {part} sangat tidak rata. Ratakan dengan spons lembap, lalu tambah tipis-tipis di bagian yang kosong.

en.title: Very patchy colour
en.say: The blush on your {part} is very uneven. Even it out with a damp sponge, then add thin layers where it is bare.

rules.measure: hue angle (LCh) of the detected blush minus the chosen shade's hue; positive = towards orange / brown

id.title: Warna sedikit lebih hangat
id.say: Blush yang kamu pakai sedikit lebih oranye dari warna pilihanmu. Tidak apa-apa, tapi untuk look yang sama pilih blush yang lebih pink.

en.title: Colour slightly warmer
en.say: Your blush is a little more orange than the shade you chose. That is fine; for the same look pick a pinker blush.

id.title: Warna lebih hangat dari pilihan
id.say: Blush yang kamu pakai jelas lebih oranye atau cokelat dari warna pilihanmu. Kalau ingin sama, ganti produk yang lebih pink, atau pilih warna yang mirip produkmu di Try On.

en.title: Colour warmer than chosen
en.say: Your blush is clearly more orange or brown than your chosen shade. To match, use a pinker product, or pick a shade closer to yours on Try On.

id.title: Warna sangat berbeda
id.say: Warna blush yang kamu pakai berbeda jauh dari pilihanmu. Tambahkan warna produkmu lewat tombol + di Try On supaya area garis putus-putus dan hasil bisa dibandingkan.

en.title: Very different colour
en.say: Your blush colour is far from the shade you chose. Add your product's colour with the + button on Try On so target and result can be compared.

id.title: Warna sedikit lebih dingin
id.say: Blush yang kamu pakai sedikit lebih pink keunguan dari pilihanmu. Untuk look yang sama pilih blush yang lebih hangat.

en.title: Colour slightly cooler
en.say: Your blush is a little more purple-pink than your chosen shade. For the same look pick a warmer blush.

id.title: Warna lebih dingin dari pilihan
id.say: Blush yang kamu pakai jelas lebih pink keunguan dari pilihanmu. Ganti produk yang lebih hangat, atau pilih warna yang mirip produkmu di Try On.

en.title: Colour cooler than chosen
en.say: Your blush is clearly more purple-pink than your chosen shade. Use a warmer product, or pick a shade closer to yours on Try On.

id.title: Warna sangat berbeda
id.say: Warna blush yang kamu pakai berbeda jauh dari pilihanmu. Tambahkan warna produkmu lewat tombol + di Try On.

en.title: Very different colour
en.say: Your blush colour is far from the shade you chose. Add your product's colour with the + button on Try On.

rules.measure: share of the target nose-bridge band covered by blush

id.title: Batang hidung kurang
id.say: Look Sunkissed butuh sedikit warna di batang hidung; masih kosong. Sapukan sisa blush di kuas tipis-tipis melintang hidung.

en.title: Nose bridge a little bare
en.say: Sunkissed needs a little colour across the nose; it is not there yet. Sweep the leftover blush on your brush lightly across it.

id.title: Batang hidung belum diberi warna
id.say: Batang hidung masih kosong. Sapukan blush tipis dari pipi kiri, melewati hidung, ke pipi kanan.

en.title: Nose bridge missing colour
en.say: The nose bridge has almost no colour. Sweep a thin layer from one cheek over the nose to the other.

id.title: Batang hidung kosong
id.say: Belum ada warna di batang hidung, jadi look Sunkissed belum terlihat. Sapukan sisa blush tipis melintang hidung.

en.title: Nose bridge bare
en.say: There is no colour on the nose bridge, so the Sunkissed look is missing. Sweep the leftover blush thinly across the nose.

id.title: Hidung sedikit terlalu merah
id.say: Warna di batang hidung sedikit lebih pekat dari Try On. Tepuk dengan spons bersih.

en.title: Nose slightly too red
en.say: The colour on the nose bridge is a little stronger than your try-on. Pat it with a clean sponge.

id.title: Hidung terlalu merah
id.say: Batang hidung lebih pekat dari Try On, jadi terlihat seperti terbakar. Tekan dengan spons atau tisu sampai warnanya turun.

en.title: Nose too red
en.say: The nose bridge is stronger than your try-on and looks sunburnt. Press with a sponge or tissue until it fades.

id.title: Hidung jauh terlalu merah
id.say: Batang hidung lebih pekat dari Try On. Hapus dan sapukan ulang dengan sisa produk di kuas saja.

en.title: Nose far too red
en.say: The nose bridge is stronger than your try-on. Remove it and sweep again with only what is left on the brush.

rules.measure: how far (mm) the blush reaches along the target axis towards the temple, minus the target reach

id.title: Kurang naik ke pelipis
id.say: Look Lifted naik ke pelipis, tapi blush di {part} berhenti sedikit lebih awal. Baurkan ujung luar ke atas.

en.title: Not quite up to the temple
en.say: Lifted rises to the temple, but the blush on your {part} stops short. Blend the outer end upward.

id.title: Belum sampai pelipis
id.say: Blush di {part} berhenti sebelum pelipis. Sapukan sisa produk dari ujung luar blush naik ke pelipis.

en.title: Not reaching the temple
en.say: The blush on your {part} stops before the temple. Sweep the leftover product from the outer end up to the temple.

id.title: Efek lifted belum terlihat
id.say: Blush di {part} tidak naik ke pelipis sama sekali. Ulangi langkah 3 mengikuti panah ke arah pelipis.

en.title: Lifted effect missing
en.say: The blush on your {part} does not rise to the temple at all. Redo step 3 following the arrow towards the temple.

symmetry.suppressed_by: any blush.offset.* hit on either side in the same direction

id.title: Tinggi kiri-kanan sedikit beda
id.say: Blush {part} sedikit lebih tinggi dari {other}. Tambah sedikit di atas sisi yang lebih rendah supaya sejajar.

en.title: Heights slightly uneven
en.say: The blush on your {part} sits a little higher than the {other}. Add a little above the lower side to level them.

id.title: Tinggi kiri-kanan berbeda
id.say: Blush {part} lebih tinggi dari {other}. Pakai garis di layar sebagai patokan: rapikan sisi yang tinggi dan tambah di sisi yang rendah.

en.title: Uneven heights
en.say: The blush on your {part} is higher than the {other}. Use the lines on screen as a guide: tidy the high side and add to the low side.

id.title: Tinggi kiri-kanan jauh berbeda
id.say: Blush {part} lebih tinggi dari {other}. Ulangi sisi yang meleset dari area garis putus-putus dengan lingkaran di layar.

en.title: Very uneven heights
en.say: The blush on your {part} is higher than the {other}. Redo the side that is off target using the circle on screen.

id.title: Kepekatan sedikit beda
id.say: Blush {part} sedikit lebih pekat dari {other}. Tambah satu tepukan tipis di {other}.

en.title: Strength slightly uneven
en.say: The blush on your {part} is a little stronger than the {other}. Add one light dab to the {other}.

id.title: Kepekatan kiri-kanan berbeda
id.say: Blush {part} lebih pekat dari {other}. Tepuk {part} dengan spons bersih atau tambah di {other} sampai sama.

en.title: Uneven strength
en.say: The blush on your {part} is stronger than the {other}. Pat the {part} with a clean sponge or build up the {other} until they match.

id.title: Kepekatan jauh berbeda
id.say: Blush {part} lebih pekat dari {other}. Samakan dulu sisi yang paling dekat dengan area garis putus-putus, lalu ikuti sisi itu.

en.title: Very uneven strength
en.say: The blush on your {part} is stronger than the {other}. Fix the side closest to the dotted area first, then match the other to it.

id.title: Ukuran sedikit beda
id.say: Blush {part} sedikit lebih lebar dari {other}. Baurkan {other} sedikit lebih keluar.

en.title: Size slightly uneven
en.say: The blush on your {part} is a little wider than the {other}. Blend the {other} a little further out.

id.title: Ukuran kiri-kanan berbeda
id.say: Blush {part} lebih lebar dari {other}. Rapikan pinggiran {part} atau baurkan {other} sampai garis luar.

en.title: Uneven size
en.say: The blush on your {part} is wider than the {other}. Tidy the {part}'s edge or blend the {other} out to the outer line.

id.title: Ukuran jauh berbeda
id.say: Blush {part} lebih lebar dari {other}. Samakan keduanya dengan garis luar di layar.

en.title: Very uneven size
en.say: The blush on your {part} is wider than the {other}. Match both to the outer line on screen.

praise.when: head, arch and tail metrics all ok

id.title: Bentuk alis pas
id.say: Pangkal, lengkung dan ekor {part} sudah mengikuti bentuk pilihanmu.

en.title: Brow shape is right
en.say: The head, arch and tail of your {part} follow your chosen shape.

id.title: Isian alis rata
id.say: Isian alis rata dan pangkalnya lembut, terlihat natural.

en.title: Even fill
en.say: The fill is even and the head is soft, so it looks natural.

id.title: Kedua alis seimbang
id.say: Tinggi, panjang dan ketebalan kedua alis sudah seimbang.

en.title: Brows match
en.say: Height, length and thickness match on both brows.

rules.measure: fires when < 15% of the target mask got darker than before and the brow outline did not change

id.title: Alis belum diisi
id.say: Kami tidak melihat perubahan di {part}. Ulangi dari langkah 2: tandai tiga titik di garis panduan, lalu isi dari tengah ke ekor.
steps: Sisir alis ke atas dengan spoolie.
Tandai titik pangkal, lengkung dan ujung di garis panduan.
Isi tipis dari tengah ke ekor, lalu sisir ke pangkal.

en.title: Brow not filled yet
en.say: We see no change on your {part}. Start again from step 2: mark three dots on the guide, then fill from the middle to the tail.
steps: Brush the brow up with the spoolie.
Mark the head, arch and end dots on the guide.
Fill lightly from the middle to the tail, then brush into the head.

rules.measure: u of the detected brow's inner start minus the target head (negative = starts closer to the nose)

id.title: Pangkal sedikit terlalu ke dalam
id.say: Pangkal {part} mulai sedikit lebih dekat ke hidung dari garis panduan. Usap ujung dalamnya dengan cotton bud sampai titik pangkal.

en.title: Head slightly too far in
en.say: Your {part} starts a little closer to the nose than the guide. Wipe the inner end with a cotton bud back to the head dot.

id.title: Pangkal terlalu dekat hidung
id.say: Pangkal {part} melewati titik pangkal ke arah hidung, jadi kedua alis terlihat menyatu. Hapus bagian itu dengan cotton bud dan sedikit micellar water.

en.title: Head too close to the nose
en.say: Your {part} goes past the head dot towards the nose, which makes the brows look joined. Remove that part with a cotton bud and a little micellar water.

id.title: Pangkal jauh terlalu ke dalam
id.say: Pangkal {part} melewati batas, hampir di batang hidung. Hapus pangkal itu dan mulai lagi dari titik pangkal di layar.

en.title: Head far too far in
en.say: Your {part} starts past its limit, almost on the nose bridge. Remove the head and start again from the head dot on screen.

rules.measure: u of the detected inner start minus the target head (positive = starts too far out)

id.title: Pangkal sedikit terlalu ke luar
id.say: Pangkal {part} mulai sedikit setelah titik pangkal. Tambah bulu tipis ke arah dalam sampai titik itu.

en.title: Head starts slightly late
en.say: Your {part} starts a little after the head dot. Add light hair-like strokes inward up to the dot.

id.title: Pangkal terlalu pendek
id.say: Bagian awal {part} di dekat titik pangkal masih kosong. Isi dengan goresan tipis ke atas seperti bulu, lalu sisir dengan spoolie.

en.title: Head too short
en.say: The start of your {part}, next to the head dot, is empty. Fill with thin upward hair-like strokes, then brush with the spoolie.

id.title: Pangkal belum diisi
id.say: Pangkal {part} masih kosong. Ulangi langkah 4: sisir isian dari tengah ke pangkal, lalu tambah goresan tipis di pangkal.

en.title: Head not filled
en.say: The head of your {part} is still empty. Redo step 4: brush the fill from the middle into the head, then add thin strokes at the head.

rules.measure: v of the detected head's centre minus the target head

id.title: Pangkal sedikit terlalu tinggi
id.say: Pangkal {part} sedikit lebih tinggi dari garis panduan. Isi sedikit di bawah pangkal dan rapikan bagian atas dengan cotton bud.

en.title: Head slightly high
en.say: The head of your {part} is a little higher than the guide. Fill a little below it and tidy the top with a cotton bud.

id.title: Pangkal terlalu tinggi
id.say: Pangkal {part} di atas garis panduan, jadi wajah terlihat kaget. Hapus bagian atas pangkal dan isi ulang di dalam garis panduan.

en.title: Head too high
en.say: The head of your {part} is above the guide, which looks surprised. Remove the top of the head and refill inside the guide.

id.title: Pangkal jauh terlalu tinggi
id.say: Pangkal {part} di atas garis panduan. Hapus pangkal dan ulangi garis bawahnya dari titik pangkal.

en.title: Head far too high
en.say: The head of your {part} is above the guide. Remove the head and redraw its lower line from the head dot.

rules.measure: v of the detected head's centre minus the target head
